attendance.title: Attendance report
attendance.footer: Times use each row’s shift timezone. Overtime requires at least 60 completed minutes after scheduled duty end and matching Super Admin approval; the full requested duration is credited. Pending, rejected, stale and historical unapproved requests earn zero credit. Actual late (min) greater than 5 still deducts a fixed 30 minutes, regardless of extra work or late approval. Completed workdays below 8h 30m also deduct the missing worked minutes. Open attendance and nonworking days have no shortage deduction.
attendance.unknownOvertime: {count, plural, one {# historical work-hour balance is unknown} other {# historical work-hour balances are unknown}}; approval-based credit and known attendance deductions are included normally.
